// =============================================================================

// ⭐ Wandering Flame — Zero Power: Meteor Impact (cinematic finisher)

// =============================================================================

// OUTER script: runs on the GM client (BD ANIMATION state). Resolves the

// caster + party targets, builds the PIXI "scriptSource", and broadcasts it to

// every client via game.ONI.pseudo.play. A per-run doneHook fires at the

// meteor's impact (whiteout peak); the outer then emits oni:animationEnd so BD

// applies the skill's damage on impact. All beats are drawn as PIXI objects on

// canvas.stage and driven by canvas.app.ticker tweens.

//

// Never emits on the reserved "world" socket (host-crash class) — cross-client

// playback is the pseudo channel; hook emits are local-only.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ZeroPower][MeteorImpact]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.zeroPower.meteorImpact";

// ── Assets ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const METEOR_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Celestial_Bodies/PlanetAtmo_05_Regular_Red_800x800.webm";

const EXPLOSION_URL = "modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/05-spell/level3/fireaball/Fireball_1_CARTOON_EXPLOSION_ORANGE_1200x1200.webm";

const WF_FALLBACK = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Beastiary/WanderingFlame_Standard.png";

const CUTIN_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav"; // universal cut-in sting

const JUMP_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HighJump.ogg";

const CHARGE_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ChargingA.wav";

const WHOOSH_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Fire1.ogg";

const IMPACT_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Amalthea_Explosion.ogg";

const LAND_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_DOWNC.wav";

// ── Tuning (all timings ms, all sizes are screen fractions/px) ─────────────

// Pacing target: "slow but impending" — long menacing build, ominous holds.

const CFG = {

// Beat 0 — boss cut-in (token sprite as portrait)

cutinDimAlpha: 0.74, cutinDimFadeMs: 340,

cutinSlideInMs: 620, cutinHoldMs: 1500, cutinSlideOutMs: 520,

cutinPortraitHeightRatio: 0.94, cutinPortraitX: 0.34, cutinPortraitY: 0.54,

// Beat 1 — jump (fast, snappy)

jumpCrouchMs: 170, jumpUpMs: 320,

// Beat 2 — hard cut to sky, then boss slowly slides down = camera pan-up illusion

cutToBlackMs: 150, cutFromBlackMs: 240, skySlideInMs: 1750, wfSettleHoldMs: 320,

// Beat 3 — STUTTERED meteor charge (grows huge, overflows top of screen)

meteorGrowSteps: 6, meteorStepGrowMs: 230, meteorStepHoldMs: 300, meteorHoldMs: 900,

// Beat 3b — camera zoom-out reveal (shrink WF + meteor together)

zoomOutMs: 640, zoomOutScale: 0.26, zoomHoldMs: 460, zoomCenterX: 0.5, zoomCenterY: 0.5,

// Beat 4 — throw (diagonal SE)

throwWindupMs: 500, throwMs: 680,

// Beat 5 — pan down to black, then lift a black curtain up (pan-down illusion)

panDownMs: 660, panBlackHoldMs: 260, panRevealMs: 1550, battlefieldHoldMs: 360,

// Beat 6 — crash (larger + slower descent = impending impact)

crashHangMs: 520, crashInMs: 1750,

// Beat 7 — whiteout (damage lands here); hold full white before fading back

whiteInMs: 240, whiteHoldMs: 3000, whiteOutMs: 680,

// Beat 8 — WF falls back to its spot

fallInMs: 860, landSquashMs: 240, endPadMs: 340,

// Sizes (× screen height, converted to world px at runtime)

wfSkySizeH: 0.32, meteorStartSizeH: 0.06, meteorMaxSizeH: 3.4, meteorGlowMul: 1.12,

crashStartSizeH: 0.45, crashEndSizeH: 0.92, explosionSizeH: 1.1, dustSizeH: 0.34, shadowMaxSizeH: 0.62,

// Screen-fraction anchors

wfSkyX: 0.42, wfSkyY: 0.80,

// meteor DRIFTS upward as it grows: starts low & visible (no empty early

// phase), ends centered high so at absurd size its lower half looms over the

// boss while the boss stays visible beneath it (chucking it).

meteorSkyX: 0.44, meteorSkyYStart: 0.10, meteorSkyYEnd: -1.0,

throwOffX: 1.6, throwOffY: 1.7,

crashStartX: 0.10, crashStartY: -0.22,

impactFallbackX: 0.5, impactFallbackY: 0.60,

// Audio

cutinSfxVol: 0.85, jumpVol: 0.7, chargeVol: 0.6, whooshVol: 0.5, impactVol: 0.9, landVol: 0.5,

// Layers (z on canvas.stage)

zSky: 3000, zShadow: 3350, zProjectile: 3400, zExplosion: 3500, zCaster: 3600,

zCutinDim: 9000, zCutin: 9050, zWhite: 999999,

totalTimeoutMs: 30000,

};

// ── Token resolution (from BD payload / globals) ───────────────────────────

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) {

try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? (d?.documentName === "Token" ? d.object : null) ?? null; }

catch (_) { return null; }

}

function resolveSource() {

const cands = [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid];

for (const c of cands) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

const ctrl = canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0];

return ctrl ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS))

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length)

for (const u of (P?.targetTokenUuids ?? [])) { const t = tokFromUuid(u); if (t) out.push(t); }

const seen = new Set();

return out.filter(t => { const k = t?.document?.uuid ?? t?.id; if (!k || seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; });

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

if (!sourceToken) { console.warn(TAG, "no caster token — aborting"); return; }

if (typeof game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play !== "function") { console.error(TAG, "ONI Pseudo API missing"); return; }

const wfUrl = sourceToken.actor?.img || WF_FALLBACK;

const doneHook = ANIM_KEY + ".done." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

// ── Inner PIXI script (runs on EVERY client) ───────────────────────────────

// NOTE: no backticks and no ${ } inside this template — it is String.raw'd.

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

if (!caster) { throw new Error("MeteorImpact pseudo: missing casterToken"); }

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

// Snapshot the camera transform once (camera is never moved — all motion is

// overlays, so a per-client camera lock/offset can't desync us).

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (screenPx) => screenPx / ZOOM; // screen px -> world px

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H); // screen-height fraction -> world px

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const clamp = (n, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));

const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2, 3)/2;

const spawned = [];

function track(o) { if (o) spawned.push(o); return o; }

function alive(o) { return !!o && !o.destroyed && !!o.position; }

function addChildTo(parent, o, z) { o.zIndex = Number(z)||0; parent.sortableChildren = true; parent.addChild(o); parent.sortChildren?.(); return o; }

function destroyObj(o) {

try { if (o && o._vid) { o._vid.pause(); o._vid.src = ""; o._vid.load?.(); } } catch(_) {}

try { if (o?.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); } catch(_) {}

try { o?.destroy?.({ children: true }); } catch(_) {}

}

function tween(onUpdate, from, to, durMs, easeFn) {

easeFn = easeFn || easeInOutCubic;

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const dur = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

const step = () => {

const t = clamp((performance.now() - start) / dur, 0, 1);

try { onUpdate(lerp(from, to, easeFn(t)), t); }

catch (e) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(false); return; }

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(true); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function fadeAlpha(o, from, to, durMs, easeFn) {

if (!alive(o)) return Promise.resolve(false);

o.alpha = from;

return tween(v => { if (!alive(o)) throw 0; o.alpha = v; }, from, to, durMs, easeFn || easeOutCubic);

}

function tweenXY(o, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, durMs, easeFn, onStep) {

if (!alive(o)) return Promise.resolve(false);

return tween((_v, t) => {

if (!alive(o)) throw 0;

const e = (easeFn || easeInOutCubic)(t);

o.x = lerp(fromX, toX, e); o.y = lerp(fromY, toY, e);

try { onStep && onStep(t, e); } catch(_) {}

}, 0, 1, durMs, (x)=>x);

}

const loadTex = globalThis.loadTextureSafe ?? loadTexture;

async function makeImageSprite(url) {

const tex = await loadTex(url);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5);

return sp;

}

// Fresh <video> per use so we never mutate Foundry's shared texture cache.

async function makeVideoSprite(url, loop) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = !!loop; vid.playsInline = true;

vid.autoplay = true; vid.preload = "auto"; vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

try { await vid.play(); } catch(_) {}

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5);

sp._vid = vid;

return sp;

}

function sizeSquare(sp, worldPx) { sp.width = worldPx; sp.height = worldPx; }

function playAudio(src, vol, rate) {

try {

const a = new Audio(src); a.preload = "auto";

a.volume = clamp(Number(vol)||0, 0, 1);

a.playbackRate = clamp(Number(rate)||1, 0.5, 4);

a.play().catch(()=>{});

return a;

} catch(_) { return null; }

}

// Screenshake on the rendered board (overlays live in it, so they shake too).

const SHAKE_STYLE_ID = "fud-meteor-shake-style";

function ensureShakeStyle() {

if (document.getElementById(SHAKE_STYLE_ID)) return;

const css = "@keyframes fud-meteor-shake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}"

+ "10%{transform:translate(-12px,9px)}20%{transform:translate(11px,-8px)}"

+ "30%{transform:translate(-9px,-10px)}40%{transform:translate(9px,9px)}"

+ "50%{transform:translate(-8px,6px)}60%{transform:translate(8px,-6px)}"

+ "70%{transform:translate(-5px,5px)}80%{transform:translate(5px,4px)}"

+ "90%{transform:translate(-3px,-3px)}}"

+ ".fud-meteor-shake{animation:fud-meteor-shake .62s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both;}";

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = SHAKE_STYLE_ID; st.textContent = css;

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

function screenShake() {

try {

ensureShakeStyle();

const board = canvas.app?.view ?? document.getElementById("board");

if (!board) return;

board.classList.remove("fud-meteor-shake");

void board.offsetWidth;

board.classList.add("fud-meteor-shake");

setTimeout(() => { try { board.classList.remove("fud-meteor-shake"); } catch(_){} }, 720);

} catch(_) {}

}

// Radial glow / dust puff sprite from a generated canvas texture.

function makeRadial(colorInner, colorOuter) {

const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = 256; cv.height = 256;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(128,128,0,128,128,128);

grd.addColorStop(0, colorInner); grd.addColorStop(0.5, colorOuter); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(128,128,128,0,Math.PI*2); g.fill();

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(PIXI.Texture.from(cv));

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return sp;

}

// Night-to-ember sky gradient covering the viewport (+margins).

function makeSkyGradient(worldW, worldH) {

const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = 8; cv.height = 256;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const grd = g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,256);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#05060f"); grd.addColorStop(0.55, "#0c0a1c"); grd.addColorStop(1, "#3a1220");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.fillRect(0,0,8,256);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(PIXI.Texture.from(cv));

sp.anchor.set(0,0); sp.width = worldW; sp.height = worldH;

return sp;

}

// Facing sign taken from the RENDERED mesh scale (folds in Mirror-Horizontal +

// texture.scaleX + facing) — the ground truth for which way the token looks.

const baseMesh = caster.mesh ?? caster.icon;

const casterSignX = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const casterSignY = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.y || 1) || 1;

// ── Caster clone (matches the rendered token sprite, incl. flip) ───────────

function makeCasterClone() {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(baseMesh?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.EMPTY);

sp.anchor.set(0.5);

sp.x = caster.center.x; sp.y = caster.center.y;

if (baseMesh) {

sp.width = Math.abs(baseMesh.width); sp.height = Math.abs(baseMesh.height); sp.angle = baseMesh.angle ?? 0;

}

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * casterSignX;

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * casterSignY;

return sp;

}

// ── State / cleanup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const origTokRenderable = caster.renderable ?? true;

const origMeshRenderable = baseMesh?.renderable ?? true;

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch(_) {} }

// Hide the WHOLE token container via 'renderable' (not 'visible'): Foundry's

// refresh recomputes 'visible' from the vision system and would un-hide the

// token the moment the clone leaves, and setting visible=false sticks so the

// token never comes back. renderable=false isn't touched by refresh, and a

// per-tick guard re-asserts it against any cull pass. Restore un-sets it and

// fires a renderFlags refresh so Foundry recomputes the correct final state.

let hideGuard = null;

function startHideGuard() {

if (hideGuard) return;

hideGuard = () => { try { caster.renderable = false; if (baseMesh) baseMesh.renderable = false; } catch(_){} };

ticker.add(hideGuard);

}

function stopHideGuard() { if (hideGuard) { try { ticker.remove(hideGuard); } catch(_){} hideGuard = null; } }

function restoreCaster() {

stopHideGuard();

try {

caster.renderable = origTokRenderable;

if (baseMesh) { baseMesh.renderable = origMeshRenderable; baseMesh.visible = true; }

caster.renderFlags?.set?.({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true });

} catch(_){}

}

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

// Impact point (party centroid, else fallback anchor) in world coords.

let impactW;

if (targetTokens.length) {

let sx = 0, sy = 0;

for (const t of targetTokens) { sx += t.center.x; sy += t.center.y; }

impactW = { x: sx / targetTokens.length, y: sy / targetTokens.length };

} else {

impactW = S2W(cfg.impactFallbackX, cfg.impactFallbackY);

}

// ── The sky "view" container (pans as one unit) ────────────────────────────

const skyView = new PIXI.Container();

skyView.sortableChildren = true;

const H_world = wLen(H) * 1.35; // one screen-height (+margin) in world px

const coverTL = S2W(-0.18, -0.18);

const coverW = S2W(1.18, -0.18).x - coverTL.x;

const coverH = S2W(-0.18, 1.18).y - coverTL.y;

try {

ensureShakeStyle();

startHideGuard(); // keep the real token hidden for the whole sequence

// ---- Beat 0: boss cut-in (token sprite as portrait) ------------------

const cutDim = new PIXI.Graphics();

cutDim.beginFill(0x000000, 1); cutDim.drawRect(coverTL.x, coverTL.y, coverW, coverH); cutDim.endFill();

cutDim.alpha = 0;

addChildTo(stage, cutDim, cfg.zCutinDim); track(cutDim);

await fadeAlpha(cutDim, 0, cfg.cutinDimAlpha, cfg.cutinDimFadeMs, easeOutCubic);

playAudio(A.cutin, cfg.cutinSfxVol, 1.0);

const portrait = await makeImageSprite(A.wf);

const pH = hPx(cfg.cutinPortraitHeightRatio);

const pAspect = (portrait.texture.width && portrait.texture.height) ? (portrait.texture.width / portrait.texture.height) : 0.72;

portrait.height = pH; portrait.width = pH * pAspect;

portrait.scale.x = Math.abs(portrait.scale.x) * casterSignX;

const pRest = S2W(cfg.cutinPortraitX, cfg.cutinPortraitY);

const pOff = S2W(-0.45, cfg.cutinPortraitY);

portrait.x = pOff.x; portrait.y = pRest.y;

addChildTo(stage, portrait, cfg.zCutin); track(portrait);

await tweenXY(portrait, portrait.x, pRest.x, portrait.y, pRest.y, cfg.cutinSlideInMs, easeOutCubic);

await waitMs(cfg.cutinHoldMs);

const pExit = S2W(1.45, cfg.cutinPortraitY);

await tweenXY(portrait, portrait.x, pExit.x, portrait.y, pRest.y, cfg.cutinSlideOutMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(portrait);

await fadeAlpha(cutDim, cfg.cutinDimAlpha, 0, cfg.cutinDimFadeMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(cutDim);

// ---- Beat 1: quick crouch + fast leap off the top --------------------

const clone = track(makeCasterClone());

addChildTo(stage, clone, cfg.zCaster);

const homeX = clone.x, homeY = clone.y;

const baseSy = clone.scale.y, baseSx = clone.scale.x;

await tween(v => { if (!alive(clone)) throw 0; clone.scale.y = baseSy * v; clone.y = homeY + (1 - v) * hPx(0.02); },

1, 0.80, cfg.jumpCrouchMs, easeOutCubic);

playAudio(A.jump, cfg.jumpVol, 1.0);

const topY = S2W(0.5, -0.4).y;

await Promise.all([

tweenXY(clone, homeX, homeX + hPx(0.01), homeY, topY, cfg.jumpUpMs, easeInCubic),

tween(v => { if (!alive(clone)) throw 0; clone.scale.y = v; clone.scale.x = baseSx < 0 ? -Math.abs(v) : Math.abs(v); },

Math.abs(baseSy) * 0.80, Math.abs(baseSy) * 1.06, cfg.jumpUpMs, easeOutCubic),

]);

destroyObj(clone);

// ---- Beat 2: hard cut to the sky, then boss SLOWLY slides down --------

// (the slow descent from the top sells a slow upward camera pan).

const cutBlack = new PIXI.Graphics();

cutBlack.beginFill(0x000000, 1); cutBlack.drawRect(coverTL.x, coverTL.y, coverW, coverH); cutBlack.endFill();

cutBlack.alpha = 0;

addChildTo(stage, cutBlack, cfg.zCutinDim); track(cutBlack);

await fadeAlpha(cutBlack, 0, 1, cfg.cutToBlackMs, easeInCubic);

// Build the sky (static) with WF parked above the top edge.

const sky = makeSkyGradient(coverW, coverH);

sky.x = coverTL.x; sky.y = coverTL.y;

addChildTo(skyView, sky, 0);

const wfSky = await makeImageSprite(A.wf);

const wfW = hPx(cfg.wfSkySizeH);

const wfAspect = (wfSky.texture.height && wfSky.texture.width) ? (wfSky.texture.height / wfSky.texture.width) : 1.35;

wfSky.width = wfW; wfSky.height = wfW * wfAspect;

wfSky.scale.x = Math.abs(wfSky.scale.x) * casterSignX; // match token facing

const wfRest = S2W(cfg.wfSkyX, cfg.wfSkyY);

const wfTop = S2W(cfg.wfSkyX, -0.4);

wfSky.x = wfRest.x; wfSky.y = wfTop.y; wfSky.alpha = 1;

addChildTo(skyView, wfSky, 2); track(wfSky);

addChildTo(stage, skyView, cfg.zSky); track(skyView);

skyView.y = 0; // static — the pan illusion comes from WF sliding, not the layer

await fadeAlpha(cutBlack, 1, 0, cfg.cutFromBlackMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(cutBlack);

// Slow descent into frame (camera pan-up illusion).

await tweenXY(wfSky, wfSky.x, wfRest.x, wfSky.y, wfRest.y, cfg.skySlideInMs, easeOutCubic);

await waitMs(cfg.wfSettleHoldMs);

// ---- Beat 3: STUTTERED meteor charge (grows huge + DRIFTS upward) -----

playAudio(A.charge, cfg.chargeVol, 1.0);

const mCx = S2W(cfg.meteorSkyX, 0).x; // constant x

const mYStart = S2W(cfg.meteorSkyX, cfg.meteorSkyYStart).y; // low + visible

const mYEnd = S2W(cfg.meteorSkyX, cfg.meteorSkyYEnd).y; // high (final loom)

const glow = makeRadial("rgba(255,220,150,0.95)", "rgba(255,90,20,0.5)");

glow.x = mCx; glow.y = mYStart;

const startS = hPx(cfg.meteorStartSizeH);

const maxS = hPx(cfg.meteorMaxSizeH);

sizeSquare(glow, startS * cfg.meteorGlowMul); glow.alpha = 0;

addChildTo(skyView, glow, 3); track(glow);

const meteor = await makeVideoSprite(A.meteor, true);

meteor.x = mCx; meteor.y = mYStart; meteor.alpha = 0;

sizeSquare(meteor, startS);

addChildTo(skyView, meteor, 4); track(meteor);

fadeAlpha(meteor, 0, 1, 280, easeOutCubic);

fadeAlpha(glow, 0, 0.85, 280, easeOutCubic);

// As the meteor swells it drifts up (center rises), so its lower cap stays in

// frame the whole time and the top overflows more the bigger it gets.

const fracs = [0.14, 0.28, 0.44, 0.62, 0.82, 1.0];

const steps = Math.min(cfg.meteorGrowSteps, fracs.length);

let curS = startS, curY = mYStart;

for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {

const nextS = startS + (maxS - startS) * fracs[i];

const nextY = lerp(mYStart, mYEnd, fracs[i]);

const s0 = curS, s1 = nextS, y0 = curY, y1 = nextY;

// spurt: snap larger while drifting up

await tween((_v, t) => {

if (!alive(meteor)) throw 0;

const e = easeOutCubic(t);

const s = lerp(s0, s1, e), yy = lerp(y0, y1, e);

sizeSquare(meteor, s); meteor.x = mCx; meteor.y = yy; meteor.rotation += 0.004;

if (alive(glow)) { sizeSquare(glow, s * cfg.meteorGlowMul); glow.x = mCx; glow.y = yy; }

}, 0, 1, cfg.meteorStepGrowMs, (x)=>x);

curS = nextS; curY = nextY;

// =============================================================================

// Wandering Flame - Flame Claw (basic melee, Tier 1 / simple, pure PIXI)

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][WF][FlameClaw]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.wf.flameClaw";

slashStaggerMs: 85, // gap between the three rake strokes

slashWipeMs: 130, // stroke draw-in time

slashHoldMs: 60,

slashFadeMs: 220,

slashLen: 0.16, // screen-height fraction

slashSpread: 0.045,

slashArch: 0.03,

slashAngle: -0.6, // radians

emberCount: 12,

emberMs: 420,

endPadMs: 180,

totalTimeoutMs: 6000,

};

// -- Token resolution (BD payload / globals) --------------------------------

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) {

try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; }

}

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) {

const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS))

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

// -- Hook plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

// -- Inner PIXI script (runs on EVERY client) -------------------------------

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

// quadratic bezier point

function quadPt(P0, C, P1, t) {

const u = 1 - t;

return { x: u*u*P0.x + 2*u*t*C.x + t*t*P1.x, y: u*u*P0.y + 2*u*t*C.y + t*t*P1.y };

}

g.clear();

g.lineStyle(glowW, 0xff6a1a, 0.35);

g.lineStyle(coreW, 0xffe07a, 0.95);

g.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);

for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) g.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);

}

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.emberCount; i++) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

const r = hPx(0.004 + Math.random() * 0.004);

g.beginFill(0xffb03a, 1).drawCircle(0, 0, r).endFill();

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

g.zIndex = 9001; g.x = center.x; g.y = center.y;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

const dist = hPx(0.03 + Math.random() * 0.06);

const dx = Math.cos(a) * dist, dy = Math.sin(a) * dist - hPx(0.02);

const sx = g.x, sy = g.y;

tween((v) => { g.x = sx + dx * v; g.y = sy + dy * v; g.alpha = 1 - v; g.scale.set(1 - 0.5 * v); },

cfg.emberMs * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6), easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(g));

}

}

try {

const tgt = targetTokens[0];

const c = tgt ? { x: tgt.center.x, y: tgt.center.y } : (function () { const q = S2W(0.5, 0.5); return { x: q.x, y: q.y }; })();

const len = hPx(cfg.slashLen);

const ang = cfg.slashAngle;

const dir = { x: Math.cos(ang), y: Math.sin(ang) };

const nrm = { x: -dir.y, y: dir.x };

const slashes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

slashes.push((async () => {

await waitMs(i * cfg.slashStaggerMs);

const off = (i - 1) * hPx(cfg.slashSpread);

const mid = { x: c.x + nrm.x * off, y: c.y + nrm.y * off };

const P0 = { x: mid.x - dir.x * len / 2, y: mid.y - dir.y * len / 2 };

const P1 = { x: mid.x + dir.x * len / 2, y: mid.y + dir.y * len / 2 };

const C = { x: mid.x + nrm.x * hPx(cfg.slashArch), y: mid.y + nrm.y * hPx(cfg.slashArch) };

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.zIndex = 9000; g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

await tween((p) => redrawSlash(g, P0, C, P1, p, hPx(0.006), hPx(0.022)), cfg.slashWipeMs, easeOutCubic);

if (i === 1) { fireDone({ ok: true }); spawnEmbers(c); }

await waitMs(cfg.slashHoldMs);

await tween((p) => { g.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.slashFadeMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(g);

})());

}

await Promise.all(slashes);

fireDone({ ok: true });

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][FlameClaw]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

// -- Orchestration (GM) -----------------------------------------------------

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: {} },

meta: { source: "Flame Claw" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// =============================================================================

// Wandering Flame - Spitblaze (basic ranged, Tier 1 / simple, pure PIXI)

// =============================================================================

// A small spit-like ember bolt lobs from the caster to the target, trailing a

// short comet tail, then pops in a compact flame burst on contact. doneHook

// fires on impact so BD applies damage there. No webm assets.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][WF][Spitblaze]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.wf.spitblaze";

const CFG = {

travelMs: 380,

arcHeight: 0.05, // screen-height fraction lob

boltCore: 0.010,

boltHalo: 0.024,

trailEveryMs: 16,

trailFadeMs: 260,

burstMs: 300,

burstRing: 0.06,

emberCount: 8,

emberMs: 360,

endPadMs: 140,

totalTimeoutMs: 6000,

};

// -- Token resolution (BD payload / globals) --------------------------------

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) {

try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; }

}

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) {

const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS))

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

// -- Hook plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

// -- Inner PIXI script (runs on EVERY client) -------------------------------

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const ADD = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function pt(tok, fx, fy) {

if (tok?.center) return { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const q = S2W(fx, fy); return { x: q.x, y: q.y };

}

function spawnTrail(x, y) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics().beginFill(0xff9a3a, 0.7).drawCircle(0, 0, hPx(cfg.boltCore * 0.8)).endFill();

g.blendMode = ADD; g.zIndex = 8999; g.x = x; g.y = y;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

tween((v) => { g.alpha = 0.7 * (1 - v); g.scale.set(1 - 0.6 * v); }, cfg.trailFadeMs, easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(g));

}

function spawnBurst(center) {

const ring = new PIXI.Graphics();

ring.zIndex = 9001; ring.blendMode = ADD; ring.x = center.x; ring.y = center.y;

stage.addChild(ring); spawned.push(ring);

const maxR = hPx(cfg.burstRing);

tween((v) => {

ring.clear();

ring.lineStyle(hPx(0.006) * (1 - v) + hPx(0.002), 0xffca5a, 0.9 * (1 - v));

ring.drawCircle(0, 0, maxR * v);

ring.beginFill(0xffd77a, 0.5 * (1 - v)).drawCircle(0, 0, maxR * 0.5 * v).endFill();

}, cfg.burstMs, easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(ring));

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.emberCount; i++) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics().beginFill(0xffb03a, 1).drawCircle(0, 0, hPx(0.004 + Math.random() * 0.003)).endFill();

g.blendMode = ADD; g.zIndex = 9002; g.x = center.x; g.y = center.y;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, dist = hPx(0.02 + Math.random() * 0.05);

const dx = Math.cos(a) * dist, dy = Math.sin(a) * dist, sx = g.x, sy = g.y;

tween((v) => { g.x = sx + dx * v; g.y = sy + dy * v; g.alpha = 1 - v; }, cfg.emberMs * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6), easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(g));

}

}

try {

const start = pt(caster, 0.3, 0.5);

const end = pt(targetTokens[0], 0.7, 0.5);

const bolt = new PIXI.Container();

bolt.zIndex = 9000; bolt.x = start.x; bolt.y = start.y;

const halo = new PIXI.Graphics().beginFill(0xff7a1e, 0.5).drawCircle(0, 0, hPx(cfg.boltHalo)).endFill();

halo.blendMode = ADD;

const core = new PIXI.Graphics().beginFill(0xffe38a, 1).drawCircle(0, 0, hPx(cfg.boltCore)).endFill();

core.blendMode = ADD;

bolt.addChild(halo, core);

stage.addChild(bolt); spawned.push(bolt);

const arc = hPx(cfg.arcHeight);

let lastTrail = 0;

await tween((p) => {

const x = start.x + (end.x - start.x) * p;

const yLin = start.y + (end.y - start.y) * p;

bolt.x = x; bolt.y = yLin - Math.sin(Math.PI * p) * arc;

const fl = 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3;

core.scale.set(fl); halo.scale.set(fl);

const now = performance.now();

if (now - lastTrail > cfg.trailEveryMs) { lastTrail = now; spawnTrail(bolt.x, bolt.y); }

}, cfg.travelMs, easeInCubic);

fireDone({ ok: true });

destroyObj(bolt);

spawnBurst(end);

await waitMs(cfg.burstMs + cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Spitblaze]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

// -- Orchestration (GM) -----------------------------------------------------

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: {} },

meta: { source: "Spitblaze" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
